name: localization-check
description: Flags hardcoded user-facing strings in changed JavaScript and TypeScript files

commands.title: Localization: Localize All in Current File with Copilot

localizationCheck.scriptPath.description: Optional path to a localization check script in the scanned project, relative to the workspace root. Used by the full-check command.

localizationCheck.liveScan.description: Underline hardcoded strings live as you edit .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx files.

localizationCheck.diagnosticSeverity.description: Severity used for live diagnostics in the Problems panel. Use 'error' to make unlocalized text show as an error.

localizationCheck.liveScanOnlyChangedFil.description: Only show live localization diagnostics for files changed in Git or unsaved editor buffers. Disable this to scan every open file.

localizationCheck.warnOnStage.description: Show a warning notification when files staged for commit contain hardcoded text that isn't localized. Requires the optional scriptPath script to exist in the scanned project.

localizationCheck.enableCodeLens.description: Display clickable 'Add localization with Copilot' CodeLens buttons directly above lines containing hardcoded text.

localizationCheck.copilotPromptHint.description: Optional custom prompt instructions passed to Copilot when generating localization replacements (e.g., 'Use react-intl formatMessage' or 'Use i18n t()').

localizationCheck.dictionaryPath.description: Optional relative path to primary localization JSON dictionary (e.g., 'src/utils/localization/lang-json/en.json' or 'locales/en.json'). If empty, en.json is auto-discovered.

localizationCheck.autoUpdateDictionary.description: Automatically insert generated translation keys and English values into en.json (and sibling locale files) when Copilot localizes strings.

localizationCheck.autoImportTranslation.description: Automatically insert missing i18n imports (e.g. useTranslation) and hook declarations (const { t } = useTranslation()) into the file.
